title: code.reply-pr-comments input
description: The orchestrated step envelope as code.reply-pr-comments sees it. `boundNote` is the approved payload: which comments to reply to and the exact body for each. `pr.comments` supplies each thread's file/line/url.

artifacts.description: `draftedReplies` holds the triage round's drafts; `postedReplies` records what earlier rounds already posted.

boundAction.description: Set to this action on the turn it runs.

boundNote.description: The replies to draft, verbatim: one entry per comment id with the exact body. Written by the controller (`code.orchestrate-pr`), not the user — the user only sees and approves this content once this action turns it into a write-draft card.

pr.description: Live PR facts kept by the watcher.

id.description: `issue:<n>` for a conversation comment, `review:<node-id>` for a review or inline comment.
